visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a wide concourse of Fukuoka Airport. A tall, decorative wooden structure with intricate traditional patterns stands as a centerpiece. People with backpacks and luggage walk through the bright hall. Large black directional signs with white text point towards gates 50A-59. (2) A fast montage shows several retail storefronts: Onitsuka Tiger with its blue and red logo, Issey Miyake's minimalist gray entrance, and Porter's classic black-and-white sign. The environment is clean with polished floors and bright studio-style lighting. (3) The view shifts to the cosmetics section, showcasing high-end brand counters like Hermes and IPSA. Wooden shelves are filled with colorful skincare bottles and makeup palettes. Soft, even lighting illuminates the product displays. (4) A wide shot captures a large circular shopping area with a reflective ceiling and various boutique kiosks including YSL and Chanel. People are browsing the aisles. (5) The entrance to the 'Hakata Food Hall' is shown, featuring large wooden pillars and traditional Japanese lanterns hanging from the ceiling. A digital directory board lists multiple food options. (6) A bright waiting area (gate lounge) appears with rows of modern wooden chairs featuring purple-red cushions. Large floor-to-ceiling windows look out onto the airfield, and a decorative cherry blossom branch is visible in the background. (7) A close-up focuses on a wooden armrest between seats that contains four black electrical outlets. A hand with a thumbs-up gesture enters the frame briefly. (8) The final scenes show the 'Bus / Shuttle Bus' lobby and the 'Departures' security entrance, followed by a 'Duty Free Shop North' filled with packaged Japanese snacks like KitKat. People are seen queuing and walking in these busy transport hubs.
